description.narrative: This project contributes to the wider dissemination and roll out of the ‘Believe in Change’ toolkit with key stakeholders within the Catholic community and potential donors. The toolkit has been shared and piloted with SECAM, CI Heads of agencies, CIDSE, UN and other key actors. The dissemination of the toolkit will be undertaken in collaboration with the CIDSE Gender Working Group. CAFOD’s previous gender advisor will accompany some of the next major steps in that process through the CIDSE group starting with a training of trainers workshop on the Gender and Catholic Church toolkit facilitated by CIDSE in Vienna on the 23rd and 24th of April 2018. Several CAFOD gender focal points will participate in this training. Other gender focal points will be instructed in the use of the toolkit at an individual level. This project also entails an element of partner networking with like-minded external advocacy organisations and/or gender resource agencies in the Middle East and West Africa regions to ensure CAFOD and respective partners are linked up with strategic networks. At the end of the project period a short report will be produced.
